1.0.0.en: First release: control your Honeywell Home T5 thermostat from Homey — temperature, humidity, mode (Off/Heat/Cool/Auto), operating status, and the current fan mode. Flow cards for setting the mode and for setting the heating and cooling setpoints together (for Auto mode). A Recent activity log on each device shows the latest changes, and Insights records value history. Works with both Honeywell Home / Resideo and First Alert accounts.

1.2.0.en: Broader support for the Honeywell Home thermostat range (T5, T6, T9, T10) and refreshed app and device artwork.

1.3.0.en: New app and device icons, real product photography for the store and device images, and broader support across the Honeywell Home thermostat range (T5, T6, T9, T10).
